Martian Robots

Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 27, 2026

Short version: Martian Robots does not collect, sell, share, or transmit your personal information to the developer. It has no accounts, analytics, advertising, telemetry, or tracking.

1. Scope

This policy applies to the Martian Robots Chrome extension and its companion web application (together, “Martian Robots”). Martian Robots is an independent tool for exploring publicly available Mars rover imagery and metadata.

2. Information we collect

We do not collect personal information or usage data. Martian Robots does not require an account and does not operate a developer-controlled server for user data. In particular, we do not collect or transmit names, email addresses, identifiers, browsing history, location, payment information, image selections, or analytics/telemetry data.

3. Local browser storage

Martian Robots may store a small amount of functional data locally in your browser, such as your selected visual theme, optional image-correction settings, and a local cache of Mars-day availability. This data stays on your device, is not sent to the developer, and can be removed by clearing the extension or site data in your browser.

4. NASA and JPL data requests

To display rover imagery, Martian Robots requests publicly available image metadata and archive products directly from mars.nasa.gov and pds-imaging.jpl.nasa.gov. These requests are made from your browser to those services. NASA/JPL may process technical request information, such as your IP address, under their own privacy practices. Martian Robots does not receive, retain, or control that information.

5. Downloads, clipboard, and sharing

When you explicitly choose to download imagery metadata or copy a shareable state or image URL list, the action is performed locally by your browser. Martian Robots does not upload those files or clipboard contents to the developer. Shareable links encode explorer state in the link itself; do not share a link if you do not want its selected Mars-explorer state disclosed to its recipient.

6. Third-party services

Martian Robots does not include advertising, analytics, social-media trackers, or third-party code. Links that open NASA/JPL images or other external websites are governed by the privacy policies of those sites.

7. Children’s privacy

Because Martian Robots does not collect personal information, it does not knowingly collect personal information from children.

8. Changes to this policy

If this policy changes, the updated version and its revision date will be published on this page.

9. Contact

For questions about this policy or Martian Robots, please open an issue in the Martian Robots GitHub repository.

Martian Robots is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by NASA or JPL. Mars rover imagery and data are provided by NASA/JPL-Caltech.
